ayahs.meta_en: The Pre-Terminal Earthly Punishments
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Ayah 47 Lexicon: Invariant root-level scientific and linguistic precision aligning with cosmic truth.

english_translations.sahih_international: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
english_translations.pickthall: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment besides this: But most of them understand not.
english_translations.shakir: And surely those who are unjust shall have a punishment besides that (in the world), but most of them do not know.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The unjust will suffer other torments besides this but most of them do not know.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment (i.e. the torment in this world and in their graves) before this, but most of them know not. [Tafsir At-Tabari, Vol. 27, Page 36].
english_translations.arberry: And there surely awaits the evildoers a chastisement beyond even that, but most of them know it not.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika fa-innaka bi-aʿyuninā wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika ḥīna taqūmu
ayahs.translation_bn: তুমি ধৈর্য ধরে তোমার প্রতিপালকের হুকুমের অপেক্ষায় থাক, কারণ তুমি আমার চোখের সামনেই আছ। আর তুমি তোমার প্রতিপালকের প্রশংসা ঘোষণা কর যখন তুমি উঠ (মাজলিস শেষে, অথবা বিছানা ছেড়ে কিংবা নামাযের জন্য)।
ayahs.translation_en: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
ayahs.conventional_en: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তুমি তোমার রবের সিদ্ধান্তের জন্য ধৈর্য ধরো; নিশ্চয় তুমি আমাদের চোখের সামনে; আর তোমার রবের প্রশংসাসহ পবিত্রতা ঘোষণা করো যখন তুমি দাঁড়াও।

ayahs.meta_en: The Divine Watchful Care & Constant Glorification
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Ayah 48 Lexicon: Invariant root-level scientific and linguistic precision aligning with cosmic truth.

english_translations.sahih_international: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
english_translations.pickthall: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Now await in patience the command of thy Lord: for verily thou art in Our eyes: and celebrate the praises of thy Lord the while thou standest forth,
english_translations.shakir: And wait patiently for the judgment of your Lord, for surely you are before Our eyes, and sing the praise of your Lord when you rise;
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Wait patiently for the command of your Lord. We are watching over you. Glorify your Lord when you rise during the night
english_translations.mohsin_khan: So wait patiently (O Muhammad SAW) for the Decision of your Lord, for verily, you are under Our Eyes, and glorify the Praises of your Lord when you get up from sleep.
english_translations.arberry: And be thou patient under the judgment of thy Lord; surely thou art before Our eyes. And proclaim the praise of thy Lord when thou arisest,

ayahs.transliteration: wamina al-layli fasabbiḥ'hu wa-id'bāra l-nujūmi
ayahs.translation_bn: আর রাত্রিকালে তাঁর প্রশংসা ও মহিমা ঘোষণা কর আর (রাতের শেষভাগে যখন) তারকারাজি অস্তমিত হয়ে যায়।

words.translation_bn: অতঃপর তার পবিত্র মহিমা ঘোষণা করো

ayahs.translation_en: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
ayahs.conventional_en: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর রাতের কিছু অংশে এবং তারাগুলোর অস্ত যাওয়ার সময় তার পবিত্রতা ঘোষণা করো।
